Keep visual space clean with the ample storage space for media essentials with this TV stand that accommodates flat screen TVs up to 75".

products.product_name: Commix Down Filled Overstuffed Loveseat by Modway
products.product_description: A haven for cozy relaxation, the Commix 2-Seater Sofa features plush comfort, clean-lined design, and a spacious profile, that makes an attractive statement in the modern home. Upholstered in polyester fabric that grants a luxe linen texture, this contemporary loveseat comes with solid wood construction and plush cushions for a luxurious sink-in feel. Commix comes with generously padded down feather and cotton cushions, and padded foam bases, making this sectional sofa collection perfect for the living room, family room, or game room. Made for sprawling out or curling up, Commix beckons you and guests to sit and stay a while. Includes plastic foot glides. Weight Capacity: 660 lbs.

This retro glam armchair boasts an intriguing silhouette enhanced with a three-button tufted backrest complemented by gently spayed gold stainless steel legs. A harmonizing presence in mid-century modern, contemporary, or eclectic decors, this velvet armchair is a precious accent chair in the bedroom, office, or entryway. Renata is equipped with stain-resistant performance velvet fabric and non-marking foot glides to protect your floors. This velvet armchair provides comfort with a webbed support system and dense foam padding. Weight Capacity: 331 lbs.
